items.quote: “I just want a distressed deal.” ⠀ We’ve all heard this from clients.
items.statement: Clients express a desire for distressed deals.

items.quote: In this video, I show you — in a real, live call — exactly how I close this type of pushy objection.
items.statement: The author demonstrates real-time objection handling in a video.

items.quote: Share with your colleague who is complaining that the buyers are not serious.
items.statement: The author suggests sharing the video with colleagues to address complaints about serious buyers.

overview: This source chunk is a LinkedIn post that discusses handling client objections in sales, particularly in real estate deals where clients seek distressed properties.
